canonicalization.numeric_contract: Integers are JSON numbers. Non-integer thresholds and doses are strings.

corpus_contract.block_rule: Tokenize each source row independently, take nonoverlapping 128-ID blocks in source order, and discard that row's final remainder.

merkle_contract.leaf_preimage: UTF8(leaf_domain) || restricted canonical block object without leaf_sha256
merkle_contract.odd_node_rule: Duplicate the final node at that level.

required_frozen_outputs_before_gpu: dataset snapshot identity and provider file hashes
selection rank and source row/block indices
source snapshot canonical SHA-256 and dataset/tokenizer file-list hashes
corpus_contract.skip_rule: Skip a row only when it is empty after Unicode whitespace checking.

source_snapshot_contract.boundary: The freezer validates and binds the supplied canonical per-file snapshot. The provider cache must be independently inventoried and hashed before this input exists.

determinism_contract.failure_handling: Any source, hash, shape, token, hook, determinism, gradient, or numeric-gate failure produces TECHNICAL_CANARY_FAIL and retains the failed receipt.

estimator_contract.eight_block_reduction: equal-weight arithmetic mean of complete per-block matrices, only after every local check passes
estimator_contract.exact_formula: J_l = (1/111) * sum_{t=16..126} sum_{t'=t..126} partial h_11,t' / partial h_l,t
estimator_contract.linear_frame_nonclaim: W_U times J_l omits nonlinear final LayerNorm and may be used only as a deliberately named pre-final-norm linear frame. It is not the official Jacobian-lens logit readout.
estimator_contract.matrix_orientation: Rows are target hidden dimensions; columns are source hidden dimensions.
estimator_contract.official_unembed_path: Pythia final_layer_norm followed by embed_out; apply configured logit softcap if present

exact_token_adapter_contract: fit prompt values are registered block_id strings, not natural-language text
encode(block_id,max_length=128) returns the exact registered 128 token IDs
the tokenizer is never called by encode
unknown block IDs, any non-128 max_length, wrong token count, out-of-vocabulary ID, or hash mismatch raise ExactTokenContractError
ExactTokenContractError is a RuntimeError so pinned jlens.fit cannot silently convert a contract violation into its ValueError skip path

resource_boundary.300B_boundary: This dense 768-wide small-model canary proves no 300B capacity. A 300B lane requires projected JVP/VJP or randomized low-rank sketches, sharding, checkpointing, and preregistered reconstruction-error gates.
resource_boundary.cost_rule: Record measured peak VRAM, wall time, and provider cost. An estimate is not an execution receipt.
resource_boundary.reference_backward_sweeps_formula: 8 blocks * 96 backward passes. The three source layers share each backward pass in the pinned implementation; the receipt must record actual backward calls.

stop_conditions: The protocol digest lacks the required external timestamp or anchor.
Any implementation, dependency, dataset, model, tokenizer, token block, or manifest hash differs.
The production worker or production secrets would be used.
The GPU exposes less than 24 GB VRAM.
Any exact-token adapter condition fails or any block would be skipped.
Any output is presented as semantic, customer-verdict, universality, prompt-injection, output-control, or 300B evidence.

subject.model_artifact_manifest_rule: Each exact relative filename and its raw SHA-256 must match this object. No aggregate manifest digest substitutes for the per-file checks.

all_required_gates: all eight registered blocks execute; no skip is permitted
every local Jacobian is finite float32 with shape 768x768
hook paths, sequence length, position mask, and token hashes match
no tokenizer call, BOS insertion, EOS insertion, padding, or truncation
three repeated local matrices on the first two blocks have maximum pairwise relative Frobenius difference <= 1e-5
same-prompt direct JVP versus J_l*u relative error <= 1e-4
same-prompt direct VJP bilinear versus v dot J_l*u relative error <= 1e-4
at least 95% output-functional sign agreement among above-noise cases
no missing, zero, disconnected, or nonfinite gradient

direction_generation.bit_mapping: 0 maps to -1 and 1 maps to +1; consume most-significant bit first from successive SHA-256 counter blocks
direction_generation.normalization: divide the first 768 signs by sqrt(768)

local_jvp_vjp_check.bilinear_prediction: d(v dot Y)/dalpha = v dot J_l*u at alpha=0.
direct_methods: torch.func.jvp or mathematically equivalent forward-mode JVP
torch.autograd VJP on the same block and same prompt
local_jvp_vjp_check.source_intervention: Add alpha*u to complete block output h_l,t at every t in 16..126.

output_functional_check.affine_fit: Ordinary least squares with intercept over all seven frozen relative doses independently for each block; report R2 and slope.
output_functional_check.baseline_token_selection: Select top1 and top2 token IDs from baseline logits; ties resolve to lowest token ID.
output_functional_check.dose_application: alpha = relative_dose * s; add alpha*u at only source position 126.
output_functional_check.functional: F(alpha) = logit[baseline_top1_id] - logit[baseline_top2_id] at output position 127; token IDs stay frozen for every dose.
output_functional_check.intervention_location: complete block output after layer 6 and before layer 7
output_functional_check.logit_stage: after final_layer_norm and embed_out, before softmax; Pythia config must report no final logit softcap or the configured softcap must be applied
output_functional_check.noise_floor: max(1e-8, 10 times the maximum absolute difference among three repeated alpha=0 evaluations)
output_functional_check.scale: s = median across all eight blocks and all layer-6 positions 16..126 of norm(h_6,t)/sqrt(768); require finite s > 0.
output_functional_check.sign_rule: Values with absolute magnitude below noise_floor have sign 0; compute sign agreement only above noise.
output_functional_check.unit_direction: Use the registered SHA-256 Rademacher source direction for this block and layer.
